blocks.zh: 製藥微生物實驗室的數據完整性
blocks.en: Data Integrity in the Pharmaceutical Microbiology Laboratory

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 辨識微生物實驗室中數據完整性違規的常見型態，包括結果偽造與記錄操控
blocks.en: Recognize the common patterns of data integrity violations in the microbiology laboratory, including falsification of results and manipulation of records

blocks.zh: 掌握稽核/查核員進行訪談分析師、現場觀察及工作單審查的核心技巧
blocks.en: Master the core techniques an auditor/inspector uses for interviewing analysts, on-site observation and worksheet review

blocks.zh: 了解委外（合約）實驗室的監管責任與數據完整性風險控制要求
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory responsibilities of outsourced (contract) laboratories and the requirements for controlling data integrity risks

blocks.zh: 識別環境監測（EM）、無菌試驗與細菌內毒素試驗（BET）中影響數據完整性的關鍵操作陷阱
blocks.en: Identify the key operational pitfalls affecting data integrity in environmental monitoring (EM), sterility testing and bacterial endotoxins testing (BET)

blocks.zh: 理解為何微生物數據完整性問題往往在記錄階段之前即已發生，需從源頭預防
blocks.en: Understand why microbiology data integrity problems often occur before the recording stage and must be prevented at the source

blocks.zh: 5.1 General Considerations and Risks — 一般考量與風險
blocks.en: 5.1 General Considerations and Risks

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh:
核心概念：微生物實驗室的數據完整性挑戰
與分析化學（如 HPLC、GC）不同，微生物測試結果高度依賴人工目視判讀，缺乏儀器直接產生的電子原始數據。這使得造假行為更難追蹤，也使稽核員更難從紙本記錄中發現問題。
blocks.en:
Key concept: data integrity challenges in the microbiology laboratory
Unlike analytical chemistry (e.g., HPLC, GC), microbiology test results depend heavily on manual visual reading and lack electronic raw data generated directly by an instrument. This makes falsification harder to trace and makes it harder for auditors to spot problems in paper records.

blocks.zh:
類比：隱形的犯罪現場
就像沒有監視器的停車場更容易發生擦撞後逃逸，缺乏自動記錄的微生物實驗室更容易發生結果「悄悄修改」。Warning Letter 案例清楚說明：問題不在於設備故障，而在於人為選擇不記錄真實數據。
blocks.en:
Analogy: the invisible crime scene
Just as hit-and-run accidents are more likely in a parking lot without cameras, results are more likely to be "quietly changed" in a microbiology laboratory that lacks automatic recording. The Warning Letter cases make it clear that the problem is not equipment failure but a human choice not to record the true data.

blocks.zh:
Warning Letter 高頻違規模式
以上六個案例涵蓋最常見的違規類型：
(1) EM 陽性結果記錄為陰性；(2) 無菌試驗失敗不通報；(3) 合約實驗室稽核流於形式；(4) 實驗室根本不具備執行測試的能力；(5) 使用「非正式本子」迴避官方記錄；(6) 培養基促生長測試結果造假。每一類都有直接對應的監管後果。
blocks.en:
High-frequency violation patterns in Warning Letters
The six cases above cover the most common types of violation:
(1) EM positive results recorded as negative; (2) sterility test failures not reported; (3) perfunctory audits of contract laboratories; (4) laboratories that simply lack the capability to perform the tests; (5) use of "unofficial notebooks" to avoid the official record; (6) falsified growth promotion test results for culture media. Each type has a direct corresponding regulatory consequence.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：初步風險識別
進入微生物實驗室前，先向 QA 索取最近 12 個月的 EM 趨勢報告與無菌試驗結果摘要。若發現「無不合格結果」或「所有結果恰好在規格邊緣」，應立即提高警覺，安排深入查核。
blocks.en:
Audit practice: initial risk identification
Before entering the microbiology laboratory, ask QA for the EM trend reports and a summary of sterility test results for the last 12 months. If you find "no failing results" or "all results sit just at the edge of the specification," be alert immediately and arrange a deeper audit.

blocks.zh: 5.1.1 Interviewing Analysts — 訪談分析師
blocks.en: 5.1.1 Interviewing Analysts

blocks.zh:
核心概念：口耳相傳的「非正式 SOP」
正式 SOP 與實際操作之間的落差，往往靠口頭指示維持。老分析師傳授的「不成文規定」是數據完整性最難查覺的灰色地帶，因為這些指示不存在於任何書面文件中。
blocks.en:
Key concept: the "informal SOP" passed on by word of mouth
The gap between the formal SOP and actual practice is often held in place by verbal instructions. The "unwritten rules" taught by senior analysts are the hardest gray area of data integrity to detect, because these instructions exist in no written document.

blocks.zh:
類比：廚房師傅的口傳秘訣
就像餐廳的菜單（SOP）上寫著食材與份量，但師傅可能私下告訴學徒「這道菜只要客人不抱怨，少放一半也沒關係」。稽核員要找的正是這種「菜單以外的廚房文化」。
blocks.en:
Analogy: the chef's verbal secrets in the kitchen
The restaurant menu (SOP) lists ingredients and portions, but the chef may privately tell the apprentice, "as long as the customer doesn't complain, using half is fine." This "kitchen culture outside the menu" is exactly what the auditor is looking for.

blocks.zh:
關鍵訪談問題（Inspector's Toolkit）
以下問題特別有效：
• 「你曾經被告知要如何處理不預期出現的菌落？」
• 「當結果不合格時，你的第一步驟是什麼？」
• 「有沒有情況下，你會先記在別的地方，之後再轉寫到正式工作單？」
• 「你的主管有沒有指示你哪些數據可以不用記錄？」
訪談時注意受訪者的肢體語言與猶豫停頓，這些非語言訊號同樣重要。
blocks.en:
Key interview questions (Inspector's Toolkit)
The following questions are especially effective:
• "How have you been told to handle unexpected colonies?"
• "When a result fails, what is your first step?"
• "Are there situations in which you write something down somewhere else first and transcribe it to the official worksheet later?"
• "Has your supervisor told you which data do not need to be recorded?"
During the interview, watch the interviewee's body language and hesitations; these non-verbal signals matter as well.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：訪談策略
分別訪談資深與資淺分析師，比對兩者對「非正常結果處理流程」的描述是否一致。若資淺人員描述的步驟與 SOP 不符，應要求資深人員當場示範標準流程，觀察是否出現矛盾。
blocks.en:
Audit practice: interview strategy
Interview senior and junior analysts separately and compare whether their descriptions of the handling of "abnormal results" are consistent. If the steps described by a junior analyst do not match the SOP, ask the senior analyst to demonstrate the standard process on the spot and watch for contradictions.

blocks.zh: 5.1.2 On-site Laboratory and Sampling Review — 現場實驗室與取樣審查
blocks.en: 5.1.2 On-site Laboratory and Sampling Review

blocks.zh:
核心概念：「假陰性」的系統性來源
取樣程序缺陷可在測試前就消滅微生物，導致假陰性結果。這類問題不會出現在 LIMS 記錄中，因為污染在數據產生之前已被消除。稽核員必須評估整個樣品旅程——從取樣到孵育——而非只看最終報告。
blocks.en:
Key concept: a systematic source of "false negatives"
Defects in the sampling procedure can kill the microorganisms before testing, leading to false negative results. Such problems never appear in LIMS records, because the contamination was eliminated before any data was generated. The auditor must assess the whole sample journey, from sampling to incubation, and not just the final report.

blocks.zh:
類比：破壞證據的勘查程序
想像鑑識人員在採集指紋前用清潔劑擦拭現場——這正是過度噴灑消毒劑到取樣口的等效行為。「程序上是對的」，但結果卻已無法反映真實狀態。
blocks.en:
Analogy: a procedure that destroys the evidence
Imagine a forensic technician wiping the scene with detergent before lifting fingerprints. Over-spraying disinfectant on the sampling port is the equivalent. It is "correct according to the procedure," yet the result can no longer reflect the true state.

blocks.zh:
冰箱庫存盤點法（Freezer Inventory Technique）
這是本章最具實用價值的稽核技巧之一：直接盤點儲存的培養皿、試管外標籤（產品名稱、批號、菌種鑑定），與 LIMS 記錄交叉比對。陽性樣品的實物數量與記錄數量若不一致，即為數據完整性的直接證據，難以辯解。
blocks.en:
Freezer Inventory Technique
This is one of the most practical audit techniques in this section: directly count the stored plates and tubes and their external labels (product name, batch number, organism identification) and cross-check them against LIMS records. A mismatch between the physical number of positive samples and the number recorded is direct evidence of a data integrity failure that is hard to explain away.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：現場觀察重點
現場查核時確認：
• 取樣容器是否適合所測試的分析物（特別是內毒素測試用低結合容器）
• 消毒劑噴灑的操作是否有書面驗證接觸時間
• 樣品從取樣到開始分析的最長時間是否符合 SOP
• 冷藏/冷凍區是否有樣品存放，存放條件是否適當
blocks.en:
Audit practice: on-site observation focus
During the on-site audit, confirm:
• whether the sampling containers are suitable for the analyte being tested (especially low-binding containers for endotoxin testing)
• whether the contact time for disinfectant spraying has been validated and documented
• whether the maximum time from sampling to the start of analysis complies with the SOP
• whether samples are stored in refrigerated/frozen areas and whether the storage conditions are appropriate

blocks.zh: 5.1.3 Worksheet Review — 工作單審查
blocks.en: 5.1.3 Worksheet Review

blocks.zh:
核心概念：13 個工作單造假警示旗
本節列出的 13 個指標（a–m）是業界公認的「造假紅旗清單」，每一項都對應一種具體的操縱行為。稽核員應將此清單轉化為稽核查核表，系統性審查每份工作單。
blocks.en:
Key concept: 13 red flags for worksheet falsification
The 13 indicators (a-m) listed in this section are an industry-recognized "falsification red flag list," and each corresponds to a specific kind of manipulation. Auditors should turn this list into an audit checklist and review every worksheet against it systematically.

blocks.zh:
類比：會計稽核的對帳技巧
如同財務稽核員會比對日記帳與總帳，微生物稽核員應將工作單與設備使用日誌、批次記錄、LIMS 三方交叉比對。單一來源的數據無法自我驗證——差異就藏在各個記錄系統的縫隙之間。
blocks.en:
Analogy: the reconciliation techniques of financial auditing
Just as a financial auditor compares the journal with the general ledger, a microbiology auditor should cross-check the worksheet against the equipment usage log, the batch record and the LIMS (three-way). Data from a single source cannot verify itself; the discrepancies hide in the seams between record systems.

blocks.zh:
最高風險指標解析
(a) 工作量超出合理範圍：計算單一分析師每日最多可執行的測試數，與記錄比對。
(i) 工作單過於完美：真實工作單通常有塗改、修正、初縮寫，「完美無瑕」反而是二次謄抄的跡象。
(h) OOS 頻率改變：突然消失的 OOS 記錄，往往意味著有人在數據進入系統前即進行篩選。
blocks.en:
Analysis of the highest-risk indicators
(a) Workload beyond a reasonable range: calculate the maximum number of tests a single analyst can perform per day and compare it with the records.
(i) Worksheets that are too perfect: genuine worksheets usually have strike-throughs, corrections and initials; being "flawless" is instead a sign of a second, transcribed copy.
(h) Change in OOS frequency: OOS records that suddenly disappear often mean someone is screening the data before it enters the system.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：工作單審查步驟
1. 向 QA 索取工作單流水號完整清單，確認編號連續性（找出 (k) 缺號）
2. 比對工作單上的人員簽名與當日出勤/進入記錄（找出 (c) 異常）
3. 計算每位分析師每月完成的測試筆數，與其在崗時間對比（找出 (a) 異常）
4. 查看最近 6 個月的 OOS 發生率趨勢圖（找出 (h) 頻率突變）
blocks.en:
Audit practice: worksheet review steps
1. Ask QA for the complete list of worksheet serial numbers and confirm the numbering is continuous (to find (k) missing numbers)
2. Compare the personnel signatures on the worksheets with the attendance/entry records for that day (to find (c) anomalies)
3. Calculate the number of tests each analyst completes per month and compare it with their time on duty (to find (a) anomalies)
4. Review the OOS rate trend chart for the last 6 months (to find (h) sudden changes in frequency)

blocks.zh: 5.1.4 Contract Laboratories — 合約實驗室
blocks.en: 5.1.4 Contract Laboratories

blocks.zh:
核心概念：委外不免責——雙重責任原則
無論是製造商還是合約實驗室，監管機構將合約設施視為委託方製造作業的延伸。委託方對合約實驗室的 CGMP 合規性負有完全監管責任，不能以「我們只是委外」為由規避。
blocks.en:
Key concept: outsourcing does not remove responsibility (the dual responsibility principle)
Whether it is the manufacturer or the contract laboratory, regulators treat the contract facility as an extension of the contract giver's manufacturing operations. The contract giver bears full oversight responsibility for the contract laboratory's CGMP compliance and cannot avoid it by saying "we only outsourced it."

blocks.zh:
類比：2008 年美國 DOJ 案例的啟示
350 份工作單全部記錄「下午 1 點執行」，實驗室卻連培養基和培養箱都沒有——這如同餐廳宣稱每天中午 1 點出菜 350 份料理，廚房卻空無一物。「相同時間戳」是最容易被電腦自動分析發現的造假模式之一。
blocks.en:
Analogy: lessons from the 2008 US DOJ case
All 350 worksheets recorded the test as "performed at 1 p.m.," yet the laboratory had neither culture media nor incubators. It is like a restaurant claiming to serve 350 dishes at exactly 1 p.m. every day with an empty kitchen. An "identical timestamp" is one of the falsification patterns most easily found by automated computer analysis.

blocks.zh:
質量協議必備條款
合約談判時應明確要求：
• 委託方可隨時取得電子原始數據與 metadata（非僅紙本列印）
• 委託方有權在無預警情況下進行現場稽核
• OOS 完整調查報告必須提供，憑分析證書（CoA）不足
• 盲樣挑戰（blinded challenge）：送交已知應為 OOS 的樣品，驗證實驗室是否如實報告
若合約實驗室拒絕上述任一條款，應視為重大風險警示。
blocks.en:
Essential Quality Agreement clauses
In contract negotiations, explicitly require:
• The contract giver can obtain electronic raw data and metadata at any time (not only paper printouts)
• The contract giver has the right to conduct unannounced on-site audits
• Complete OOS investigation reports must be provided; a certificate of analysis (CoA) is not sufficient
• Blinded challenge: send samples known to be OOS to verify that the laboratory reports them truthfully
If the contract laboratory refuses any of the above clauses, treat it as a major risk warning.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：合約實驗室稽核清單
現場稽核時重點確認：
• 實驗室是否實際具備執行所委外測試項目所需的設備與耗材
• 微生物鑑定平台（如 Vitek II、MALDI-TOF、基因型方法）與委託方 EM 使用的平台是否相容，以利 OOS 調查溯源
• 工作單時間戳與設備使用日誌是否一致
• 要求查看電子系統稽核軌跡（audit trail），而非僅看列印報告
blocks.en:
Audit practice: contract laboratory audit checklist
During the on-site audit, focus on confirming:
• whether the laboratory actually has the equipment and consumables needed to perform the outsourced tests
• whether the microbial identification platform (e.g., Vitek II, MALDI-TOF, genotypic methods) is compatible with the platform the contract giver uses for EM, to allow OOS investigation traceability
• whether worksheet timestamps are consistent with the equipment usage logs
• ask to see the audit trail of the electronic systems, not just the printed report

blocks.zh: 5.1.5 Equipment and Instrument Review — 設備與儀器審查
blocks.en: 5.1.5 Equipment and Instrument Review

blocks.zh:
核心概念：設備問題 ≠ 數據完整性問題（但可能轉化）
設備未校正或失效本身是品質控制問題；但若在此狀態下仍繼續執行測試並記錄結果，即升級為數據完整性問題。區分這兩者的關鍵在於：操作者是否知情，以及是否選擇繼續使用並記錄結果。
blocks.en:
Key concept: an equipment problem is not a data integrity problem (but can turn into one)
Uncalibrated or failed equipment is in itself a quality control problem; but if testing continues and results are recorded in that state, it escalates into a data integrity problem. The key to telling the two apart is whether the operator knew and chose to keep using the equipment and recording results.

blocks.zh:
類比：用壞掉的體重計量產品
一台已漂移 5 公斤的體重計（設備問題），若刻意在年底稽核前使用它並宣稱「產品符合規格」（選擇性使用），就成了數據完整性問題。截止日期的壓力是這類行為的最常見觸發因子。
blocks.en:
Analogy: using a broken scale to weigh product
A scale that has drifted by 5 kg is an equipment problem; if it is deliberately used before a year-end audit and the product is declared "within specification" (selective use), it becomes a data integrity problem. Deadline pressure is the most common trigger of this kind of behavior.

blocks.zh:
自動鑑定系統的數位稽核軌跡
Vitek II、Biolog、MALDI-TOF 等系統會自動儲存所有鑑定記錄。稽核員可直接要求從系統中匯出特定時間段的鑑定歷史，與對應的工作單和 LIMS 記錄比對。若鑑定記錄顯示某批次有額外的菌株測試，但工作單上沒有對應記錄，即為重要發現。
blocks.en:
Digital audit trails of automated identification systems
Systems such as Vitek II, Biolog and MALDI-TOF automatically store all identification records. An auditor can ask for an export of the identification history for a given period directly from the system and compare it with the corresponding worksheets and LIMS records. If the identification records show extra strains tested for a batch but the worksheet has no corresponding entry, that is an important finding.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：設備日誌交叉比對
1. 索取培養箱、水浴槽等關鍵設備的維修/校正日誌
2. 標記設備「停用期間」（out of service dates）
3. 比對這些停用日期與對應期間的微生物工作單——若工作單顯示該設備仍在使用中的日期有測試記錄，即需說明
4. 特別關注高工作量或產品批次交貨截止日前後的時間段
blocks.en:
Audit practice: cross-checking equipment logs
1. Request the maintenance/calibration logs for key equipment such as incubators and water baths
2. Mark the equipment's "out of service" dates
3. Compare these out-of-service dates with the microbiology worksheets for the same period; if the worksheets show test records on dates when the equipment was still in use, an explanation is required
4. Pay particular attention to periods of high workload or just before batch delivery deadlines

blocks.zh: 5.2 Testing for Environmental Monitoring, Sterility, and Bacterial Endotoxins — 環境監測、無菌試驗與細菌內毒素試驗
blocks.en: 5.2 Testing for Environmental Monitoring, Sterility, and Bacterial Endotoxins

blocks.zh:
核心概念：EM、無菌試驗、BET — 三大高風險測試
這三類測試覆蓋製藥微生物實驗室最關鍵的合規領域。EM 反映製造環境狀態，無菌試驗決定產品放行，BET 保護注射劑患者安全。任何一類的數據完整性問題都可能導致受污染產品流入市場。
blocks.en:
Key concept: EM, sterility testing and BET are the three high-risk tests
These three types of tests cover the most critical compliance areas of the pharmaceutical microbiology laboratory. EM reflects the state of the manufacturing environment, sterility testing determines product release, and BET protects patients receiving injectables. A data integrity problem in any one of them can lead to contaminated product reaching the market.

blocks.zh:
類比：三道防線
EM 是預警系統（環境是否潔淨？），無菌試驗是產品把關（產品本身是否無菌？），BET 是毒素偵測（即使無菌，是否含有危險內毒素？）。三道防線的數據若被人為操控，最終受害的是患者。
blocks.en:
Analogy: three lines of defense
EM is the early warning system (is the environment clean?), the sterility test is the product gatekeeper (is the product itself sterile?), and BET is toxin detection (even if sterile, does it contain dangerous endotoxin?). If the data of the three lines of defense are manipulated, patients are the ones ultimately harmed.

blocks.zh:
ISO-5 區域的特殊重要性
ISO-5（Grade A/Class 100）是無菌充填和無菌試驗的最潔淨環境要求。EM 數據造假於此區域的後果最為嚴重，因為這直接關係到生產環境是否適合製造無菌產品的判斷。
blocks.en:
The special importance of ISO 5 areas
ISO 5 (Grade A/Class 100) is the cleanest environment required for aseptic filling and sterility testing. Falsified EM data in this area has the most serious consequences, because it bears directly on the judgment of whether the manufacturing environment is suitable for making sterile products.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：進入 5.2 前的準備
查核前取得以下清單：EM 採樣點位圖（含 ISO 等級對應）、無菌試驗 SOP 版本歷史、BET 試驗方法驗證報告。以此作為後續各子節深入查核的基準文件。
blocks.en:
Audit practice: preparation before entering 5.2
Before the audit, obtain the following: the EM sampling location map (with the ISO classification of each location), the version history of the sterility test SOP, and the BET method validation report. Use them as the baseline documents for the deeper audit of each subsection that follows.

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 Environmental Monitoring Equipment — 環境監測設備
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Environmental Monitoring Equipment

blocks.zh:
核心概念：EM 設備的雙重作用
EM 設備既是環境品質的監控工具，也是數據完整性的潛在弱點。設備本身的維護狀態直接決定所得數據是否反映真實環境狀況。設備疏漏與人為操控都可能導致相同的結果——錯誤的 EM 數據。
blocks.en:
Key concept: the dual role of EM equipment
EM equipment is both a tool for monitoring environmental quality and a potential weak point for data integrity. The maintenance status of the equipment itself directly determines whether the data obtained reflect the true state of the environment. Equipment oversights and human manipulation can lead to the same outcome: incorrect EM data.

blocks.zh:
類比：失靈的火災感應器
設計不良或堵塞的空氣採樣器就像靈敏度失效的火災偵測器——即使有火（微生物存在），也不會觸發警報。對製造管理層而言，數字「正常」並不代表環境真的正常，它可能只代表偵測系統失效了。
blocks.en:
Analogy: a faulty fire sensor
A poorly designed or blocked air sampler is like a fire detector that has lost sensitivity: even with a fire (microorganisms present), it will not trigger the alarm. For manufacturing management, "normal" numbers do not mean the environment is really normal; they may only mean the detection system has failed.

blocks.zh:
設備疏漏 vs. 蓄意操控
EM 設備的問題可分為兩類：(1) 設備維護疏漏（如未清潔、堵塞）導致的無意識假陰性；(2) 蓄意操控（如消毒後再採樣、跳過暴露時間）導致的蓄意假陰性。稽核時需同時排查兩種可能性。
blocks.en:
Equipment oversight vs. deliberate manipulation
EM equipment problems fall into two categories: (1) unintentional false negatives caused by lapses in equipment maintenance (e.g., not cleaned, blocked); (2) deliberate false negatives caused by intentional manipulation (e.g., sampling after disinfection, skipping the exposure time). Both possibilities must be investigated during an audit.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：EM 設備評估
審查 EM 設備的預防性維護記錄，確認清潔頻率、校正日期，並觀察設備實物是否有阻塞跡象或磨損。要求操作人員現場演示完整的採樣程序，與 SOP 逐步比對。
blocks.en:
Audit practice: EM equipment assessment
Review the preventive maintenance records for EM equipment, confirm the cleaning frequency and calibration dates, and inspect the equipment itself for signs of blockage or wear. Ask operators to demonstrate the complete sampling procedure on site and compare it step by step with the SOP.

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 Air Sampling Devices — 空氣採樣設備
blocks.en: 5.2.2 Air Sampling Devices

blocks.zh:
核心概念：五種空氣採樣數據完整性風險
本節列出的五個風險點（培養皿外觀確認、堵塞採樣器、品管日誌、沉降碟、最終菌落計數）涵蓋了從設備操作到結果記錄的完整數據流。任何一個環節失控都可能影響 EM 數據的真實性。
blocks.en:
Key concept: five data integrity risks in air sampling
The five risk points listed in this section (confirming the appearance of the plate, blocked samplers, QC logs, settle plates and the final colony count) cover the complete data flow from equipment operation to result recording. Loss of control at any one step can affect the authenticity of the EM data.

blocks.zh:
類比：「瓊脂壓痕」是執行的印記
空氣沖擊在瓊脂表面留下的壓痕和凹陷，就像蓋過章的印泥痕跡——它是採樣確實執行的物理證據。若培養皿沒有這些痕跡，卻有採樣記錄，即為可疑。稽核員應要求在場觀察採樣程序，並檢視已完成採樣的培養皿。
blocks.en:
Analogy: the "agar impression" is the mark of execution
The impressions and dimples left on the agar surface by the air impaction are like the ink mark of a stamp: they are physical evidence that sampling was actually performed. If a plate has no such marks but there is a sampling record, it is suspicious. The auditor should ask to observe the sampling procedure in person and examine plates from completed sampling.

blocks.zh:
不當計數調整的常見藉口
操作人員常以「邊緣菌落是來自培養皿蓋子的污染」或「最初 5 分鐘的菌落是環境背景值」作為排除計數的理由。TR80 明確指出：無充分科學依據的任何計數調整均屬數據完整性問題。規格內的調整理由必須事先在 SOP 或方法驗證中明確規定。
blocks.en:
Common excuses for improper count adjustments
Operators often justify excluding counts by saying "colonies at the edge came from contamination from the plate lid" or "colonies in the first 5 minutes are environmental background." TR80 states clearly that any count adjustment without sufficient scientific basis is a data integrity problem. Any justification for adjustments within the specification must be defined in advance in the SOP or in method validation.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：空氣採樣稽核重點
• 要求同時查看培養皿實物與計數記錄，確認瓊脂壓痕與記錄一致
• 索取採樣器清潔日誌，確認清潔頻率是否符合設備製造商建議
• 確認沉降碟的暴露位置是否遠離 UV 燈，暴露時間是否符合 SOP
• 審查分離碟（RCS/slit sampler）的計數原始記錄，是否有排除邊緣或初始時段菌落的記錄
blocks.en:
Audit practice: key points for auditing air sampling
• Ask to see the physical plates together with the count records, and confirm the agar impressions are consistent with the records
• Request the sampler cleaning log and confirm the cleaning frequency follows the equipment manufacturer's recommendation
• Confirm that the exposure location of settle plates is away from UV lamps and that the exposure time complies with the SOP
• Review the original count records for slit-to-agar samplers (RCS/slit sampler) for any record of excluding edge colonies or colonies from the initial period

blocks.zh: 5.2.3 Surface and Personnel Monitoring Equipment — 表面與人員監測設備
blocks.en: 5.2.3 Surface and Personnel Monitoring Equipment

blocks.zh:
核心概念：採樣前消毒 — 最隱蔽的造假手法
在 RODAC 碟接觸表面之前噴灑消毒劑，是一種可以讓「差的無塵室環境看起來乾淨」的有效方法，且幾乎不留任何書面痕跡。這類行為若非現場目擊，在任何記錄審查中幾乎無從發現。
blocks.en:
Key concept: disinfecting before sampling is the most hidden form of falsification
Spraying disinfectant before the RODAC plate touches the surface is an effective way to make a "poor cleanroom environment look clean," and it leaves almost no written trace. Unless it is witnessed on site, this behavior can hardly be discovered in any record review.

blocks.zh:
類比：考試前的「補充學習」
就像學生在考試前偷看答案，然後聲稱自己考了高分，在 RODAC 採樣前消毒是在「確保好成績」，但結果毫無意義——它反映的不是實際的無菌技術能力，而是操控行為。
blocks.en:
Analogy: "extra study" before an exam
Like a student who peeks at the answers before an exam and then claims a high score, disinfecting before RODAC sampling "guarantees a good result," but the result is meaningless: it reflects not the actual aseptic technique but manipulation.

blocks.zh:
人員監測的常見不當操作
TR80 指出兩種常見的不當操作：(1) 接觸時間過短（RODAC 碟未充分壓在手套/表面上）；(2) 手指未正確滾動覆蓋整個瓊脂表面，或手指重疊。這些操作缺陷雖非蓄意造假，但同樣會導致低估污染程度，影響數據的代表性。
blocks.en:
Common improper practices in personnel monitoring
TR80 identifies two common improper practices: (1) contact time that is too short (the RODAC plate not pressed firmly enough on the glove/surface); (2) fingers not rolled correctly to cover the whole agar surface, or fingers overlapping. Although these flaws are not deliberate falsification, they likewise lead to underestimating contamination and affect the representativeness of the data.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：現場觀察人員監測操作
最有效的方式是要求在正常操作中（非預告的演示）觀察人員監測的完整程序：
• 確認分析師在採樣前未對受測表面施用任何消毒劑
• 計時 RODAC 碟與表面的接觸時間是否符合 SOP（通常 10 秒以上）
• 確認手指監測時，每根手指的掌側面是否完整滾動覆蓋瓊脂表面
blocks.en:
Audit practice: observing personnel monitoring on site
The most effective approach is to ask to observe the complete personnel monitoring procedure during normal operations (not an announced demonstration):
• Confirm the analyst applies no disinfectant to the surface to be tested before sampling
• Time the contact between the RODAC plate and the surface to confirm it meets the SOP (usually 10 seconds or more)
• For finger monitoring, confirm that the palmar side of each finger is rolled fully across the agar surface

blocks.zh: 5.2.4 Review of Sterility Test — 無菌試驗審查
blocks.en: 5.2.4 Review of Sterility Test

blocks.zh:
圖示說明 Figures 5.2.4-1 to 5.2.4-3
Figure 5.2.4-1🔍 — Membrane Filter Location: 薄膜濾膜轉入試管後黏附在液面以上的試管內壁頂部，未浸入培養液。若存在污染菌，濾膜上的微生物無法與培養液接觸，導致假陰性。

Figure 5.2.4-2🔍 — Hygroscopic Powder Product: 吸濕性粉末產品黏附在試管頸部，未落入培養液。位於頸部的產品部分可能含有污染菌，卻無法與培養液接觸。

Figure 5.2.4-3🔍 — Medical Device Placement: 長型導管（如靜脈導管）未有效截短，部分器械伸出培養液液面以上。器械伸出液面的末端部位可能正是含有原生微生物污染的區域。
blocks.en:
Figures 5.2.4-1 to 5.2.4-3
Figure 5.2.4-1🔍 — Membrane Filter Location: After transfer to the tube, the membrane filter adhered to the upper inner wall of the tube above the liquid level and was not immersed in the culture medium. If contaminating organisms are present, the microorganisms on the filter cannot contact the medium, leading to a false negative.

Figure 5.2.4-2🔍 — Hygroscopic Powder Product: Hygroscopic powder product adhered to the neck of the tube and did not fall into the culture medium. The portion of product in the neck may contain contaminating organisms but cannot contact the medium.

Figure 5.2.4-3🔍 — Medical Device Placement: A long catheter (e.g., an intravenous catheter) was not effectively cut shorter, so part of the device projected above the medium surface. The end of the device projecting above the liquid may be exactly the area carrying native microbial contamination.

blocks.zh:
核心概念：無菌試驗的假陰性——問題在於測試設計之外
USP <71> 規定了無菌試驗的方法，但無法預防操作細節失誤。三個 FDA 483 觀察項目（濾膜未浸入液體、粉末黏頸部、導管未截短）的共同點是：在結果記錄之前，測試本身已經失效，而結果仍被記錄為「通過」。這是一種測試執行的數據完整性問題，而非記錄操控。
blocks.en:
Key concept: false negatives in sterility testing, where the problem lies outside the test design
USP <71> specifies the sterility test method but cannot prevent errors in operational detail. The common thread in the three FDA 483 observations (filter not immersed in liquid, powder stuck to the neck, catheter not cut shorter) is that the test itself had already failed before the result was recorded, yet the result was still recorded as "pass." This is a data integrity problem of test execution, not of record manipulation.

blocks.zh:
類比：採血時針頭沒有刺入靜脈
就像採血管因針頭位置錯誤而只採到注射用水，無菌試驗中濾膜或產品未接觸培養液，等於根本沒有進行有效測試。最終記錄的「陰性結果」不是真正的陰性——它只是「未偵測到」，因為測試從未真正開始。
blocks.en:
Analogy: the needle does not enter the vein during a blood draw
Just as a blood tube filled only with water for injection because of a wrong needle position, a sterility test in which the filter or product never touched the medium amounts to no valid test at all. The recorded "negative result" is not a true negative; it is merely "not detected," because the test never really began.

blocks.zh:
產品適用性試驗（Suitability Test）的重要性
在例行無菌試驗之前，必須先用已知的 QC 挑戰菌株驗證方法的回收能力。若促生長試驗失敗（即 QC 菌株無法正常生長），表示測試條件本身具有抑制性，所有在這條件下得到的陰性結果均不可信。這是本節最重要的品質控制概念。
blocks.en:
The importance of the product suitability test (Suitability Test)
Before routine sterility testing, the recovery capability of the method must first be verified with known QC challenge strains. If the growth promotion test fails (i.e., the QC strains cannot grow normally), the test conditions themselves are inhibitory, and no negative result obtained under those conditions can be trusted. This is the most important quality control concept in this section.

blocks.zh:
查核實務：無菌試驗現場觀察
• 確認容器外部消毒的接觸時間是否有驗證依據，且有書面規定
• 要求觀察薄膜過濾操作：確認使用的鑷子長度（10–12 英吋），並目視確認濾膜已完全浸入培養液
• 審查試管架中間位置的培養液體積是否全部符合規格（低體積問題最易被忽略）
• 對於醫療器械：確認截短程序的 SOP 是否有器械特定的長度指引，且器械完全浸入培養液
blocks.en:
Audit practice: on-site observation of sterility testing
• Confirm that the contact time for external disinfection of containers has a validated basis and is documented
• Ask to observe membrane filtration: confirm the length of the forceps used (10-12 inches) and visually confirm the filter is fully immersed in the medium
• Review whether the medium volume in the tubes in the middle positions of the rack all meets specification (low volume is the problem most easily overlooked)
• For medical devices: confirm that the SOP for cutting to shorter lengths contains device-specific length guidance and that the device is fully immersed in the medium

blocks.zh: 5.2.5 Bacterial Endotoxin Testing — 細菌內毒素試驗
blocks.en: 5.2.5 Bacterial Endotoxin Testing

blocks.zh:
核心概念：BET 三大數據完整性風險點
(1) 混合步驟缺失：內毒素可能形成微胞或吸附於瓶壁，不混合即採樣會低估實際含量；(2) MVD 計算錯誤：MVD 設定過高會使測試在過稀的濃度下進行，讓真正超標的內毒素「被稀釋至規格以下」；(3) 蓄意稀釋操控：如 DOJ 案例所示，刻意選擇超過 MVD 的稀釋倍數可使任何污染「消失」在結果之中。
blocks.en:
Key concept: three major data integrity risk points in BET
(1) Missing mixing step: endotoxin can form micelles or adsorb to the vial wall, and sampling without mixing underestimates the actual content; (2) MVD calculation error: setting the MVD too high makes the test run at an excessively dilute concentration, so that truly out-of-specification endotoxin is "diluted below the specification"; (3) Deliberate dilution manipulation: as the DOJ case shows, deliberately choosing a dilution factor beyond the MVD can make any contamination "disappear" in the results.

blocks.zh:
類比：MVD 是上限，不是目標
MVD（最大有效稀釋倍數）是防止產品干擾的計算上限，其目的是確保測試在不被產品抑制的條件下能偵測到內毒素。若將 MVD 當成「目標稀釋倍數」而過度稀釋，等於故意縮小內毒素偵測的靈敏度窗口——超標的內毒素在稀釋後可能低於 LAL 試劑的偵測下限。
blocks.en:
Analogy: the MVD is a ceiling, not a target
The MVD (maximum valid dilution) is the calculated upper limit that prevents product interference, and its purpose is to ensure endotoxin can be detected under conditions where it is not inhibited by the product. Treating the MVD as a "target dilution factor" and over-diluting deliberately narrows the sensitivity window of endotoxin detection: out-of-specification endotoxin may fall below the detection limit of the LAL reagent after dilution.

blocks.zh:
DOJ 案例的技術解析
FDA 實驗室的關鍵做法是「執行全範圍稀釋系列」（full range of product dilutions），而非只在單一稀釋倍數下測試。這個做法能揭露「Hook Effect」或過度稀釋造成的假低值。稽核員審查 BET 記錄時，應確認實驗室是否按照方法驗證中規定的稀釋方案執行，且每次測試都包含適當的陽性對照組（CSE）。
blocks.en:
Technical analysis of the DOJ case
The key practice of the FDA laboratory was to "run the full range of product dilutions" rather than testing at a single dilution factor. This approach can reveal the "Hook Effect" or falsely low values caused by over-dilution. When reviewing BET records, auditors should confirm that the laboratory followed the dilution scheme specified in method validation and that every test included an appropriate positive control (CSE).

blocks.zh:
查核實務：BET 稽核清單
• 審查 BET SOP 是否明確規定採樣前的混合步驟（尤其針對水溶液製劑）
• 驗證 MVD 計算公式是否正確，核對公式中使用的限度值（EU/mL 或 EU/mg）、濃度與給藥劑量是否與藥典專論一致
• 檢查陽性對照（CSE）的批號與效期，確認試劑未過期
• 比對工作單上使用的稀釋倍數與方法驗證報告中的規定是否一致
• 若測試結果恰好在規格邊緣，應要求提供完整的稀釋系列原始記錄
blocks.en:
Audit practice: BET audit checklist
• Review whether the BET SOP explicitly specifies the mixing step before sampling (especially for aqueous formulations)
• Verify that the MVD calculation formula is correct, and check that the limit value used in the formula (EU/mL or EU/mg), the concentration and the dose are consistent with the pharmacopoeial monograph
• Check the lot number and expiry date of the positive control (CSE) to confirm the reagent has not expired
• Compare the dilution factor used on the worksheet with the one specified in the method validation report
• If a test result is right at the edge of the specification, ask for the complete original records of the dilution series

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 微生物數據的特殊性：多數測試依賴人工目視，缺乏儀器自動記錄，使造假難以從記錄中發現，需結合訪談與現場觀察才能有效稽核
blocks.en: The special nature of microbiology data: most tests rely on manual visual reading and lack automatic instrument recording, which makes falsification hard to find in records; effective auditing requires combining interviews with on-site observation

blocks.zh: 訪談分析師：非正式口頭指示不會出現在 SOP 中；稽核員須直接詢問是否曾被要求調整數據或偏離程序，並比對資深/資淺人員的陳述
blocks.en: Interviewing analysts: informal verbal instructions never appear in the SOP; auditors must ask directly whether analysts have ever been asked to adjust data or deviate from procedures, and compare the statements of senior and junior staff

blocks.zh: 現場與工作單審查：13 個工作單造假紅旗（a–m）是核心工具；冰箱庫存盤點法可提供微生物菌株實物與記錄數量的直接比對依據
blocks.en: On-site and worksheet review: the 13 worksheet falsification red flags (a-m) are the core tool; the freezer inventory technique provides a direct basis for comparing the physical number of microbial isolates with the number recorded

blocks.zh: 合約實驗室監管：委外不免責；品質協議必須確保取得電子原始數據與 metadata 存取權；盲樣挑戰是驗證實驗室誠信的有效工具
blocks.en: Contract laboratory oversight: outsourcing does not remove responsibility; the quality agreement must ensure access to electronic raw data and metadata; blinded challenge is an effective tool for verifying a laboratory's integrity

blocks.zh: EM 與無菌試驗風險：假陰性問題往往在採樣或測試執行階段即已發生，而非在數據記錄時——預防必須從源頭（取樣、設備維護、操作程序）著手
blocks.en: EM and sterility test risks: false negatives often arise at the sampling or test execution stage rather than at data recording, so prevention must start at the source (sampling, equipment maintenance, operating procedures)

blocks.zh: BET 關鍵控制：混合步驟、MVD 正確計算、全範圍稀釋系列是防範內毒素數據操控的三道技術防線；MVD 過高設定可能導致超標內毒素在稀釋後無法偵測
blocks.en: Key BET controls: the mixing step, correct MVD calculation and a full-range dilution series are the three technical lines of defense against endotoxin data manipulation; an MVD set too high may make out-of-specification endotoxin undetectable after dilution
